claim_text: US and South Korean forces were expected to practise joint operations in complex scenarios during Ulchi Freedom Shield, including a live-fire exercise testing joint precision targeting and manoeuvre, a wet gap crossing, and distribution of prepositioned military equipment.
quote: including a live-fire exercise to test joint precision targeting and maneuver, a wet gap crossing, and distribution of prepositioned military equipment, according to the U.S. military.
confidence_justification: Exercise content attributed to the US military itself in AP's account.
